content.short: QuillAudits is a Web3 security firm providing smart-contract audits, dapp reviews, and TON security support.
content.description: QuillAudits offers Web3 security assurance through rigorous audit services for blockchain projects. Its experienced auditors perform in-depth code reviews and real-world scenario testing to uncover vulnerabilities before they can be exploited. In an industry where security breaches have driven losses beyond $35 billion, QuillAudits has supported 1000+ projects globally. The aim is to build trust among users and investors with thorough audits and a streamlined process for rapid, actionable security evaluations and remediation guidance.
content.meta: QuillAudits is a Web3 security audit firm with 1000+ projects secured globally. Discover its security role, TON relevance, and related audit tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
